letter.summary: It was good to see you today to discuss your recent blood test results and your ongoing concerns regarding fatigue and blood pressure management.
letter.findings_plain: Your recent blood tests show that your cholesterol levels are slightly higher than we would like to see, and your blood pressure reading today was 145/92, which is a little elevated. However, your kidney function and blood sugar levels are all within the normal range, which is very encouraging.

medication_changes.name: Amlodipine 5mg
medication_changes.change: Increase dosage from 2.5mg to 5mg once daily
medication_changes.reason: To better control your blood pressure readings.

medication_changes.name: Atorvastatin 10mg
medication_changes.reason: To help lower your elevated cholesterol levels.

medication_changes.name: Multivitamin
medication_changes.reason: No changes required to your current supplement routine.

letter.plan: We will focus on a heart-healthy diet, specifically reducing salt and saturated fats. I also recommend aiming for 30 minutes of brisk walking most days of the week. We will monitor your progress through a repeat blood test and blood pressure check in three months.
letter.safety_netting: If you experience any unusual swelling in your ankles, persistent headaches, or sudden changes in your vision, please contact the surgery immediately or seek urgent medical advice.
